hero.title: Property Management
hero.lede: Manage your properties with our configurable and customizable solution designed for property owners. Streamline lease management, maintenance requests through our integrated systems. Simplify rent collections, track your monthly/yearly expenses, and benefit from our in-system reporting capabilities for valuable insights

blocks.html: Our Property Management offers a comprehensive solution for property management companies, including landlords, and property managers. The system features an integrated workflow, supporting both leasing and sales contracts. It efficiently manages collection and reconciliation processes. Additionally, the solution includes configurable KPIs, allowing property owners to gain an overall view of their various properties, tenants in each, and available units. The system also generates reports for revenues and expenses and can automate the creation of contracts for printing and distribution

Multi-Currency Operations: Process transactions and maintain accounts in various currencies

Multi-Owner Management: Manage properties under multiple owners seamlessly through one screen

Units Management: Ability to manage space and various units

Facility Management: Track assets and oversee facility management operations

Cost per Unit: Calculate and analyze costs associated with each unit

Web-Based and Web-Enabled Solutions: Access the platform via any device with an internet connection

SMS and Email Integration: Send notifications and communications directly from the system through SMS and email

Oracle and SQL Server Databases: Utilize Oracle and SQL Server databases for reliable data management

Export Functionality to Excel, Word, and PDF: Easily export data and reports into Excel, Word, and PDF

Customizable Flex Fields: Adapt and configure fields to meet specific business needs and workflows
